responsibility: Declares the interfaces and summary class for nested-function lowering in the GIMPLE middle end. It exposes helpers for building addresses and frame fields, the lower_nested_functions driver, nested_function_info summary management, recording and undoing nested-function relationships in cgraph, and inline iterators for traversing a function’s nested-function chain.
same_name_distinction: Provides the exported nested-function lowering API and the nested_function_info summary/iteration helpers for cgraph relationships. Unlike gcc/tree-nested.cc, it declares the metadata and accessors rather than implementing the rewrite and unnesting pass.
